definitions.gloss: archery; the art of the bow (as a traditional Japanese martial art)
definitions.explanation: The classical Japanese martial art of shooting with a bow. Historically referred to battlefield archery practiced by samurai; today the related modern discipline {弓道|きゅうどう} is more widely practiced, with {弓術|きゅうじゅつ} retaining its older, traditional associations.

examples.japanese: {弓術|きゅうじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{弓術|きゅうじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{励|はげ}んだ→励む：11822_hagemu⟧。
examples.english: Warriors devoted themselves to practicing archery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{弓術|きゅうじゅつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられている→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: Old schools of archery are still transmitted by a small number of practitioners today.

examples.japanese: {弓術|きゅうじゅつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、{射|い}る⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{重|おも}んじられる→重んじる：14445_omonjiru⟧。

notes:
Compound of ⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧ ('bow') and ⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ ('art; technique'). The ⟦{術|じゅつ}→術：14265_jutsu⟧ suffix is standard for the names of classical Japanese martial arts: ⟦{剣術|けんじゅつ}→剣術：20194_kenjutsu⟧ ('swordsmanship'), ⟦{柔術|じゅうじゅつ}→柔術：20990_juujutsu⟧ ('jujutsu'), {槍術|そうじゅつ} ('spearmanship'), {馬術|ばじゅつ} ('horsemanship').

USAGE:
In modern Japanese, ⟦{弓道|きゅうどう}→弓道：04453_kyuudou⟧ ('the way of the bow') is the more common name for the practice of traditional archery, and is the form taught in schools and clubs. {弓術|きゅうじゅつ} carries older, more martial connotations and is used in historical writing or when referring to specific classical ryuha (schools). For Western-style sport archery, the katakana loanword アーチェリー is used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弓術|きゅうじゅつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧: to study archery
- {弓術|きゅうじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{稽古|けいこ}→稽古：00210_keiko⟧: archery practice
- {弓術|きゅうじゅつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧: school / lineage of archery
- {弓術|きゅうじゅつ}{家|か}: an archer; master of archery
- {弓術|きゅうじゅつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{秀|ひい}でる→秀でる：13749_hiideru⟧: to be skilled in archery
- ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{弓術|きゅうじゅつ}: traditional archery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弓道|きゅうどう}→弓道：04453_kyuudou⟧: modern Japanese archery (way of the bow) — the dominant contemporary term
- アーチェリー: archery — Western-style sport archery with a different bow and technique
- ⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧: bow — the weapon itself
- ⟦{矢|や}→矢：10461_ya⟧: arrow
- ⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧: target
- {射手|しゃしゅ}: archer; shooter

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditional Japanese archery uses the {和弓|わきゅう}, a distinctive asymmetric longbow held below its center. Practice emphasizes not only accuracy but also posture, breathing, and spiritual composure. The ritualized form of modern ⟦{弓道|きゅうどう}→弓道：04453_kyuudou⟧ descends from samurai-era {弓術|きゅうじゅつ}.
